notes: All 470 pieces of the parts list are present and each type/colour count matches the list.
Minifigure bodies/heads/hair are not in the parts list and are not recorded.

Build order follows the booklet: bag 1 steps 1-46, bag 2 steps 47-55, bookcase sub-build (b292-b333) placed in step 56, steps 57-59, sofa, armchair, steps 62-68, whiteboard, shopping cart (step 70), then loose accessories.

The remaining separate groups are real and kept on purpose: (1) the whiteboard easel (b426-b436) and (2) the shopping cart (b437-b450) are free-standing models the booklet builds and sets down beside the room (pages 103, 106, 107), not attached to the baseplate; (3) the Kitchen Implements Kit items (b453-b467: spare fork, knives, plates, cupcake holders, dish, spatula, pan, jug, mixer) and the brick separator (b469) have no building step at all - they are minifigure accessories/a tool, so no brick connection exists for them.

Connected where the booklet shows it: the two forks b451/b452 are placed on the round table (page 106), the dog b468 stands on the baseplate, the sticker sheet b470 is applied to the door and the post.

Sideways book stacks, wall tiles and lamps on 1x1 bricks with side studs are recorded as other_joins, not rests_on. Where booklet icons were ambiguous, parts were assigned so per-type totals match the list; rests_on for some wall bricks may be off by a neighbouring brick.

notes: All 470 pieces of the parts list are present and each type/colour count matches the list (checked by tally). The two sticker/loose-item categories (sticker sheet, brick separator, chihuahua, kitchen kit items) are loose accessories with no booklet step.
Minifigure bodies/heads/hair are not in the parts list and are not recorded.

Build order follows the booklet: bag 1 steps 1-46, bag 2 steps 47-55, bookcase sub-build (b292-b333) then placed in step 56, steps 57-59, sofa (b354-b370), armchair (b371-b387), steps 62-68, whiteboard, shopping cart (step 70), then loose accessories.
Sub-assemblies (bookcase, sofa, armchair, DNA tower, whiteboard, cart) list the supports they have in the finished model; first pieces of the whiteboard and cart rest on nothing in the model itself.

Where the booklet's small icons were ambiguous (e.g. which of several similar dark-red plates goes in a given step), I assigned parts so the per-type totals match the parts list; rests_on for wall/tower bricks is the best reading of the pictures and may be off by one neighbouring brick.
Sideways book stacks and wall tiles/lamps attached to 1x1 bricks with stud on side are recorded as other_joins (side studs), not rests_on.
The two baseplate halves b1/b3/b7 are only held together by the plates laid across their seams; b3 and b7 therefore have no piece under them.
Orange kitchen items b451/b452 are the two shown in step 70 / page 106; the rest of the Kitchen Implements Kit and the Chihuahua are loose accessories for the minifigures.
Cart parts: cones are feet under the 2x2 base; the four 42446 brackets were placed on the two top plates (best reading of icons).
The sticker sheet is joined to the door and the 1x1x5 post as examples; other printed parts (radio, Van der Graaf, physics tile etc.) are pre-printed pieces.
